goal: On the till, build a ticket with at least four different items, change a quantity, remove one line, and check that the ticket total and every line amount add up. Stop before any real payment screen.
As a first-time cashier, find how to sell two items and reach the payment step. Report anything confusing on the way. Stop before confirming a payment.
On the dashboard home and the orders page, check that the headline figures agree with each other and with the lists they summarise.
Switch the dashboard to English, then to Arabic, visit three pages in each, and report any text left in the wrong language or laid out the wrong way.
In the waiter app, open a table, add items with unusual quantities and notes, and check what is refused, what is kept, and whether anything freezes.
Put three items on a ticket, reload the page, and check whether the ticket is kept, lost, or duplicated. Then do the same after switching language.
